text: Full control over subscription changes: upgrade/downgrade plans, adjust quantity/price, add or remove add-ons
quote: Recurly gives you full control over how and when subscription changes take effect. Upgrade or downgrade a plan, adjust quantity or price, add or remove add-ons

text: When only quantity/price changes (not the plan), only the price difference is billed immediately
quote: Recurly bills only the difference during an immediate change when the underlying plan is unchanged.

text: Usage-based billing charges customers at end of cycle based on actual consumption
quote: Recurly's usage-based billing model lets you charge customers at the end of each billing cycle based on their actual consumption

text: Measured units standardize usage tracking for consistent reporting across add-ons and plans
quote: Measured units describe the usage tracked by a usage-based add-on and enable consistent reporting across multiple add-ons and plans.

text: Higher-tier plans can create up to 50 targeted marketing campaigns for customer segments
quote: merchants on Professional and Elite plans can create up to 50 targeted campaigns for different customer segments or plans

text: Provides tools to proactively catch and resolve involuntary churn causes like expired cards or failed payments
quote: Involuntary churn happens when customers are lost due to factors outside their intent — expired cards, bank changes, or failed payments. Recurly provides several tools to proactively catch and resolve these issues

text: Customers can set a backup payment method so service continues if the primary payment fails
quote: Let customers designate a backup payment method so service continues automatically if their primary payment fails.

text: Entitlements can be applied across web, mobile, and app stores and checked in real time via API
quote: Entitlements can be applied across platforms (web, mobile, and app stores) and checked in real time via the Recurly API.

text: Credits are issued as their own distinct credit invoices, separate from charge invoices
quote: Credit invoices give every credit its own distinct invoice — separate from charge invoices.

text: Invoice details (notes, due dates, PO numbers, terms) can be edited after issuance
quote: Modify invoice details post-issuance — including account notes, due dates, PO numbers, customer notes, and terms — to keep records accurate.

text: Imported data can populate accounts, support analytics, and maintain compliance records
quote: Use it to populate your account, analyze performance and customer behavior, and keep records for compliance.

text: Recurly Compass MCP server connects AI development tools directly to Recurly's docs and API knowledge
quote: Recurly Compass MCP connects your AI development tools directly to Recurly's documentation and API knowledge.

text: Official client libraries provided for Ruby, Node.js, Python, .NET, Java, PHP, and Go
quote: Official Client Libraries ### Ruby ... ### Node.js ... ### Python ... ### Dotnet ... ### Java ... ### PHP ... ### Go

text: Native mobile SDKs let developers integrate recurring payments into existing Android or iOS apps
quote: The Recurly Native Mobile SDKs allow you to integrate recurrent payments in your existing Android or iOS apps in a matter of minutes.

text: Customer data can be imported to populate accounts and records in Recurly
quote: Import customer data to populate accounts and records across your Recurly account.
